title: Broadcom's $230 Billion Guide: CoWoS Packaging Eases, But Does Customer Concentration Prove a New Bottleneck?
one_sentence_conclusion: Broadcom's Q3 beat confirms CoWoS packaging is easing, but evidence is not yet enough to prove design-partner concentration is a new structural bottleneck.

title: The Cloud Loophole: Can US Export Controls on AI Chips Survive Remote Access?
one_sentence_conclusion: A House-passed bill and draft Commerce rule aim to close China's Nvidia GPU rental loophole, but Senate delay and Huawei's ramp raise doubt.

title: The Storage Wall: Are Sold-Out Hard Drives and Soaring NAND Prices AI's Next Structural Bottleneck?
one_sentence_conclusion: AI training data, checkpoints and logs have sold out hard-drive production into 2028 and pushed NAND/SSD prices up 50-100%+, but a defined HAMR ramp and a $31B NAND fab investment already underway make this bottleneck's resolution more a matter of execution timing than open-ended scarcity.

title: The Rare-Earth Chokepoint: Are China's Yttrium and Erbium Export Controls the AI Buildout's Next Structural Bottleneck?
one_sentence_conclusion: China's near-monopoly on yttrium and erbium processing is squeezing gas-turbine and data-center optical-networking supply chains, but the restriction is a reversible trade-truce artifact expiring November 10, 2026, not a physical shortage.

title: The Permission Bottleneck: Is Local and State Political Opposition Now Blocking More AI Data-Center Capacity Than Any Physical Supply Constraint?
one_sentence_conclusion: Local and state political opposition -- roughly 38 New Jersey bans, a New York statewide pause, a Texas interconnection freeze -- is a fast-growing but so far geographically diversifiable constraint, hard only at the level of a specific committed site.

title: The AI Buildout's Human Bottleneck: Is a Skilled-Trades Labor Shortage Now Constraining Data Center Construction More Than Chips, Power Equipment or Grid Policy?
one_sentence_conclusion: A skilled-trades labor shortage -- not chips, transformers or grid policy -- is now the most immediate constraint on how fast US AI data centers get built.

title: PJM's 'Bring Your Own Power' Mandate: Has US Grid Interconnection Policy Overtaken Equipment Supply as AI Data Centers' Binding Constraint?
one_sentence_conclusion: PJM's new curtailment-priority rule doesn't create the bottleneck -- it rations a pre-existing, decade-scale scarcity of firm US generation capacity that gas-turbine lead times cannot quickly fix.

title: Helium Shortage 5.0: is the Qatar/Strait-of-Hormuz helium crisis a durable structural bottleneck on AI-driven semiconductor fabs, or a war-contingent price shock?
one_sentence_conclusion: Helium is a genuine, non-substitutable AI-fab input squeezed by a war-damaged Qatari supply and a closed Strait of Hormuz, but leading-edge fabs' buffers and 2027 normalization guidance temper its durability.

title: Optical transceivers and EML lasers: has AI GPU-cluster networking replaced packaging and memory as the AI buildout's tightest chokepoint?
one_sentence_conclusion: EML laser fabrication is a real, qualifying structural bottleneck on AI networking, but its 1-3 year capacity-doubling timeline makes it far less durable than memory, packaging or mining constraints.

title: Copper: is the physical metal behind every wire, motor and transformer becoming the AI buildout's next structural bottleneck?
one_sentence_conclusion: Copper's mine-supply rigidity is a genuine long-run bottleneck, but the current price spike looks more tariff- and DRC-driven than AI-caused.

title: The AI buildout's electrical bottleneck: are grid transformers and electrical steel -- not chips -- now the binding constraint on data center capacity?
one_sentence_conclusion: Grid transformers and the electrical steel behind them, not chips, are now the most immediate physical bottleneck delaying AI data-center capacity in 2026.

title: The AI memory supercycle: is HBM -- not packaging or substrates -- the AI accelerator supply chain's most durable structural bottleneck?
one_sentence_conclusion: High Bandwidth Memory has become the AI accelerator supply chain's longest-duration structural bottleneck, with SK Hynix's own leadership forecasting the shortage persisting to around 2030 -- longer than either the packaging or substrate constraints this pipeline previously examined.

title: ABF dielectric film and Ajinomoto's near-monopoly: the bottleneck emerging behind AI chip packaging as CoWoS eases
one_sentence_conclusion: As TSMC's CoWoS packaging capacity closes in on demand, the binding constraint on AI accelerator supply is shifting one layer upstream to ABF dielectric film and the substrates built from it -- a genuine structural bottleneck by this research's own strict test, where CoWoS assembly increasingly no longer qualifies.

title: Nvidia's $500 billion third-party AI financing push: does it solve a capital bottleneck, or relocate a credit-risk one?
one_sentence_conclusion: Capital itself is not scarce for the AI buildout, but credible, arm's-length underwriting capacity for AI compute as loan collateral is -- and Nvidia's $500 billion financing push, plus its own rapid retreat on the OpenAI Ohio guarantee, is direct evidence of exactly that constraint.

title: CoWoS advanced-packaging capacity as the binding constraint on AI accelerator supply
one_sentence_conclusion: CoWoS advanced-packaging capacity, not silicon wafer starts or HBM memory, currently qualifies as the structural bottleneck on AI accelerator supply, and its allocation is entrenching the largest incumbent buyers rather than expanding the field.

title: HBM memory supply as the binding constraint on AI accelerators
one_sentence_conclusion: HBM packaging capacity currently qualifies as a structural bottleneck for AI accelerator supply, but memory-cycle history argues for validation before conviction.
